summary.name: Glassmorphism (normalized label; category Digital and 3D Aesthetics). The label comes from a frosted-glass interface description, and negative examples are not positive evidence.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: translucent frosted panels with thin borders, soft shadows and restrained highlights. Background color shows through while text contrast stays high. Avoid stacked blur layers.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: simple layered UI cards over color, product presentations and dashboards with charts in panels. Inferred: app feature demos, SaaS onboarding and analytics summaries. Motion references are optional and scene-screened.
summary.limitations: Explicit: no blur on blur, no low-contrast white text and no charts on busy gradients. Two-color ratios do not validate glass, so inspect composited frames. Provide a solid fallback where backdrop-filter is unsupported.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene_dependent. #182837 is an illustrative swatch, not a required canvas, so choose backgrounds from scene and mood. Unapproved suggestions: foreground #F6F7F0 (13.94:1 on #182837), accent_1 #7AAEB4 and accent_2 #A698C5. Exact task-provided colors override these. An optional lab gradient from #7AAEB4 to #A698C5 applies only behind glass.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: restrained panel, mask and modest parallax motion. Video evaluates every state from paused composition time; hover, scroll and keyboard input apply only to interactive delivery. Optional scene-screened references: 008 card stacking, 011 voice-card tilt, 012 chapter handoff, 013 swipe track, 015 storytelling, and 038 punctuation zoom only with an actual punctuation mark.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style; no genre, tempo, voice or mandatory layer is required. Suggest per topic: music bed, voiceover, restrained sound accents, or silence for reading holds. Any playback needs authorized audio and stays separate from visual tilt.
summary.assetRequirements: Unspecified: subject, exact copy and duration; no upload is mandatory. If used: real product content, verified chart data only, local fonts, an actual punctuation glyph for 038, and authorized audio. Do not invent metrics or brand marks.
summary.combinations: Explicit: style-095 product motion for feature demos, and style-097 charts inside panels for dashboards. Keep at most two stacked blur layers and place gradients only behind glass. Avoid pairing with other translucent or aurora styles, which duplicate it.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline; Remotion is only the documented fallback. HTML/CSS backdrop-filter and SVG render the glass, and a paused seekable timeline owns motion. Use a color-contrast validator, then verify seeks and composited frames before export.
